label: early original-phase first occurrence of u/w/b/0/v (strongest at step 3)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at steps 0-4 (never at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or at t>=5), and almost never at t=1. Step 3 holds ~54% of activation mass, t=0 ~22%, t=2 ~15%. Within these steps it prefers the first occurrence of the input tokens u, w, b, 0, v (u and w carry the most mass); repeated tokens are rarely active. Largest activations are u (or w) at t=3, especially after an r at t=2 (e.g. p r r [u]). The token-set predicate gets dev F1 ~0.62, mass recall ~0.68; the rest is weaker firing on other tokens at t=3 (rate ~21%), partly modulated by the previous token (r, l, g), which a simple token list does not capture.
